fact: Italic is one property of the whole text element, set by an "Italic" toggle in the properties panel and by Ctrl+I / Cmd+I; there is no separate italic font.
Fonts without an italic face get a synthetic slant, and italic text must stay readable and unclipped in every script.
The last chosen italic value becomes the default for new text.
